svg.title: GuardBunny trust boundary diagram
svg.desc: Two zones separated by a vertical dashed line. Left (untrusted): User, LLM/Agent, .GB Workflow as inputs. Right (trusted): Parser, Policy Engine, Executor, Audit Log as components, with Output produced on the trusted side and returned left across the boundary.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Who are the untrusted actors in GuardBunny?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLM generate GB workflows?')
sendPrompt('What is untrusted input in GuardBunny?')
sendPrompt('What does the GuardBunny parser do?')
sendPrompt('How does the GuardBunny policy engine work?')
sendPrompt('What does the GuardBunny executor do?')
sendPrompt('What does the GuardBunny audit log capture?')
sendPrompt('What does GuardBunny output look like?')
